name: Hugging Face MCP
tagline: Run models, search the Hub, and manage Spaces from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Hugging Face MCP server. Search the Hub for models and datasets, run inference on any model (text, image, audio), deploy to Spaces, and inspect model cards. The canonical way to access the HF ecosystem from your agent.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Hugging Face MCP server, maintained by Hugging Face. Exposes the HF Hub API and Inference API as MCP tools: search for models/datasets/spaces, run inference (text generation, embeddings, image, audio), deploy to Spaces, fetch model card metadata, and download files.

## Why we recommend it

If you want your agent to have access to the entire Hugging Face ecosystem (1M+ models, 200K+ datasets, hundreds of thousands of Spaces), this is the right tool. The Inference API gives you access to hosted models without downloading anything, and the Hub search lets you discover what's available.

## When to use it

- Multi-modal agents: run image generation, audio transcription, embeddings
- Open-source model discovery: search the Hub for models that fit a use case
- Dataset exploration: query Hugging Face datasets
- Deploy agent-built apps to Spaces
installInstructions:
1. Get a Hugging Face token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens
2. Set `HF_TOKEN=hf_...`
3. `uvx mcp-huggingface`

**Pricing note:** The Hub search is free. The Inference API has free tier (limited requests/min) and Pro tier for higher throughput.
pricingDetails: Free. Hub search is free. Inference API: $0.10/hr free credit, then pay per request. Pro: $9/mo for higher throughput.
